final: WITH tallies AS (SELECT archstat AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS tally FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), shares AS (SELECT status, tally, 1.0 * tally / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM tallies) SELECT status, tally, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)
